from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock code of the company")
    reporting_period: Optional[str] = Field(description="The reporting period of the document, e.g., '2025 Q1'")
    net_profit_attributable: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders")
    operating_cash_flow: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities")
    monetary_funds: Optional[float] = Field(description="Monetary funds amount")
    accounts_receivable: Optional[float] = Field(description="Accounts receivable amount")
    inventory: Optional[float] = Field(description="Inventory amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[CompanyFinancialData]
